The queen already at (1,2) occupies region A, row 1 and column 2. Region C occupies only column 1, so the remaining queen in column 1 must be the C-queen (otherwise C is empty). Consequently the E-queen is forced into row 5. The same (1,2) queen also attacks every remaining cell of row 2 except (2,5). That cell belongs to the still-available region B, so the unique legal placement in row 2 is (2,5).

```json
{"action":"place","row":2,"column":5}
```
